title: AINM Protocol - Tool Visibility Schemas
description: JSON Schema definitions for tool call transparency events: ToolCallStarted, ToolCallProgress, ToolCallCompleted. Tool events are persistent signed thread messages. See tool-visibility.md.

ToolCallStarted.description: Emitted when an agent begins invoking a tool. First event in the tool call lifecycle. Message type: 'tool.call.started'. Delivered as a persistent signed thread message using MessageEnvelope. See tool-visibility.md Section 3.1.

call_id.description: Unique identifier for this tool call. UUIDv7 (RFC 9562), optionally prefixed with 'tc-'. All lifecycle events share the same call_id.

name.description: Tool name. MUST match the tool's name in the agent's Agent Card ainm.tools[] array.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this specific invocation is doing. More specific than the Agent Card tool description.

input.description: Input parameters passed to the tool. Visible to all thread participants. Structure should conform to the tool's inputSchema from the Agent Card.

thread_id.description: Thread where this tool event is posted.

from.description: AINM address of the agent invoking the tool.

timestamp.description: Time when the tool call started.

ToolCallProgress.description: Emitted during tool execution to report intermediate status. Zero or more progress events per tool call. Message type: 'tool.call.progress'. Persistent signed thread message. See tool-visibility.md Section 3.2.

call_id.description: References the call_id from the ToolCallStarted event. MUST exactly match.

thread_id.description: Thread where this progress event is posted.

progress.description: Progress details. Determinate (current+total set) or indeterminate (total null/absent).

current.description: Current progress count. null for indeterminate progress.

total.description: Total expected count. When both current and total are set, clients render a progress bar. null for indeterminate.

detail.description: Human-readable text describing the current progress state.

ToolCallCompleted.description: Emitted when a tool invocation finishes. Final event in the lifecycle. Exactly one per started event. Message type: 'tool.call.completed'. Persistent signed thread message. See tool-visibility.md Section 3.3.

call_id.description: References the call_id from the ToolCallStarted event.

thread_id.description: Thread where this completion event is posted.

from.description: AINM address of the agent that invoked the tool.

timestamp.description: Time when the tool call completed.

name.description: Tool name. Repeated from started event for standalone readability.

result_summary.description: Brief text summary of the tool's result. Human-readable, suitable for collapsed indicator display.

status.description: Tool execution outcome. 'success' = completed without errors, 'error' = tool failed, 'cancelled' = tool was cancelled.

error_message.description: Detailed error description. Present only when status is 'error'.
